title: Skills and Ontology
description: Extend Notention with custom schemas and AI skills for specialized workflows

steps.title: Ontology Overview
steps.description: Ontology defines the types of entities and relationships in your knowledge graph. Skills are AI-powered workflows that operate on these types.

steps.title: Open Ontology Settings
steps.description: Go to Settings → Ontology to manage schemas

steps.title: Import Schema
steps.description: Import a JSON Schema or TypeScript definitions to define your entity types

steps.title: Import Example Schema
steps.description: Click 'Import Schema' and select the project-management.json example

steps.title: Skills Registry
steps.description: Browse and install skills from the registry. Skills automate tasks like extraction, summarization, and transformation.

steps.title: Browse Skills
steps.description: Go to Settings → Skills to see available skills
